text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm passing by the arcade when I spot
some
familiar faces.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ACK! Nooo, it fell again...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I've just gotta move the arm more
smoothly and
let it grab all the way
around the cushion...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Oh, gosh, I've never been good at crane
games,
but I'm not throwing in the towel
yet! Just hang in
there, Ayabe!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You really don't have to do this...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But you really, really wanted the
blue
cushion, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Not particularly... I just said it looked
soft, that's
all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, well, there's only one way to
know for sure,
right? Let's nab it and see
just how soft and
squishy it is!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Top Road, wait! ...Geez.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Peeking over at the crane machine, I spot a light blue cushion that does look criminally soft and snuggly.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Nooooo! Not again! Why am I so bad at
this...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry, Ayabe. Let me zip over to
buy more
tokens real quick. Be right
back!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Stop. You really don't have to do this,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Remember what Ticket said the other
day? Don't
push yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'm happy that you tried to win it for me,
and I'm
grateful for how you feel, so...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I know. I hear all of you guys loud and
clear about not going overboard, and
I'm glad that you're all
looking out for
me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: But I can't help it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
If anything, it sometimes feels like stuff
like this
just adds fuel to the flames.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how sweet and caring you are, I
just—I just
want to give you my very,
very best!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You... just...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe! I know this is a selfish thing to
ask, but
um... Would you mind cheering
me on?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Cheer...ing?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! There's nothing I can't do when
I've got
someone rooting for me. So...
please?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...You're so close.
I know you'll get it on
the next
try.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Yep, I'm on it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Whew, thanks for believing in me! Now
this
cushion's all yours!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Your faith gave me the last push I
needed to
make it happen!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I spot Admire Vega out

stargazing on her new cushion with an
extra soft
smile on her face.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, I somehow got the cushion
next to it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Works for me. The color isn't important.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: This one's probably just as soft.
